plugins.name: spec-debate
plugins.changelog: v1.11.0: Claude 4.7+ temperature fix + Aug 31 2026 catalog refresh. Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 / Fable 5 / Opus 4.8 / Opus 4.7 all hard-failed with litellm.UnsupportedParamsError because the debate loop sent a temperature; those models accept only temperature=1. claude_version() now parses (major, minor) from any Claude id (bare, dated, Bedrock- or OpenRouter-prefixed) so all three temperature call sites drop the parameter together, and Anthropic keeps max_tokens over max_completion_tokens. New --claude-effort flag (low/medium/high/xhigh/max): Claude 4.6+ debaters now run at effort=low via output_config.effort, measured on Opus 5 at 155s/11.1k output tokens against 360s/25.9k at Anthropic's high default (medium saves only ~10%, so it is not the useful step-down); judges in --review-only keep high. Catalog refresh verified against live provider APIs and vendor docs: added xai/grok-4.6, gemini/gemini-3.7-flash, zai/glm-5.3, zai/glm-5.3-flash, claude-opus-4-8; retired gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-mini from the Codex ChatGPT lineup; repriced gpt-5.6-sol $4/$20, gpt-5.6-terra $2/$12, gpt-5.6-luna $0.2/$1.2, gemini-3.6-flash $0.75/$3.75, grok-4.20-reasoning $1.25/$2.5. litellm floor 1.98. v1.10.1: defensive provider fixes ported from gtm-forge - codex_auth_mode() no longer crashes on non-dict auth.json, antigravity cost matching scoped so it cannot swallow similar model ids, Codex JSONL parsing hardened against non-dict lines and flexible error fields, Gemini CLI retirement warning prints once per process. v1.10.0: August 2026 refresh — Codex ChatGPT-account handling (fail fast on non-retryable 400s with actionable hint, preflight warning when codex/ models aren't in the ChatGPT lineup; gpt-5.3-codex retired from ChatGPT accounts), new antigravity/ provider via agy CLI (Gemini CLI's successor; consumer gemini-cli retired 2026-06-18, now warns and is dropped from auto-selection), Claude 5 catalog (claude-fable-5/opus-5/sonnet-5 + Bedrock mappings), codex gpt-5.6 examples, dead deepseek-chat alias removed, litellm floor 1.96, CLI-provider retry loops deduplicated. v1.9.1: codex review fixes — export-tasks/emit-plan token-param fix for Moonshot reasoning models (kimi-k3 default broke both), OPENAI_BASE_URL misroute warning on all litellm paths, Kimi reasoning detection anchored to version segment, o3-pro doc drift reconciled. v1.9.0: July 2026 model catalog refresh — GPT-5.6 line (sol/terra/luna), Moonshot kimi-k3 and kimi-k2.7-code (temperature detection extended), xai/grok-4.5, zai/glm-5.2, gemini-3.6-flash, MiniMax-M2.7; new provider defaults; OPENAI_BASE_URL misroute warning.
